verdict_reason: The 0.4.0 best-effort stream is wired correctly with its own counters and -v4 suffix, but the README, pipeline and observability docs still describe three versions.

todos.issue: Adding the 0.4.0 stream makes the repo docs untrue: README.md:68 says each event goes out as v0.1.0, v0.2.0 and v0.3.0; docs/notification-pipeline.md:14-15 says 'published three times' and names only the -v2/-v3 suffixes and v0.2.0/v0.3.0 best-effort failures; docs/observability.md:32 lists schema.version values 0.1.0, 0.2.0, 0.3.0 and :48 only the -v2/-v3 message ids. Support reading the dashboard or runbook will not know the 0.4.0 series or the -v4 message id exist.
todos.fix: Must: every doc that lists the PIMS versions the listener sends, their ASB messageId suffixes and the schema.version meter tag values names 0.4.0 and -v4, and no doc says the event is published three times. One way: update README.md:68, docs/notification-pipeline.md:14-15 and docs/observability.md:32,48 in this PR.
